review:
A 10-line western with a dead-simple bonus. Three, four or five bonus symbols trigger it – and four add a 3x multiplier, five add 10x.

It's the same structure and ceiling as Wild Cash x9990 with a different look: very high volatility, a 10,490x max and 96.1% RTP. Most of the upside lives in rare five-symbol triggers, so expect big swings.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
